rows.en:
(I promised to hang out with Hoshimura
in Deep Akihabara today... but I bet
she's going to be late again.)
Geez! You're late, \p!

Huh! Hoshimura got here first...?
What on earth happened?

Well, today we're hanging out in Deep Akihabara!
I've been looking forward to it so, so much!

(Come to think of it, Hoshimura loves
making the rounds of junk shops and stuff.)

Hurry up, let's go, \p!
Mountains of machinery await us~!

Whew~, I bought and bought!
I scored some real finds, so I'm
suuuper satisfied!

Good for you, but...
how can you carry such heavy stuff so easily?

It's so I can tinker with these machines!
This is nothing, nothing at all.

Okay!
I need to get home ASAP, so I'm off!
Byyye~!

(Hoshimura really loves tinkering with machines.
Well, I had fun too, so I guess it was
a nice change of pace.)

(I promised to hang out with Yui
in Deep Akihabara today... but I bet
she's going to be late again.)

Huh! Yui got here first...?
What on earth happened?

(Come to think of it, Yui loves
making the rounds of junk shops and stuff.)

Good for you, but...
how can you carry such heavy stuff so easily?
Yeah, see you.
rows.notes: Female. Matches the male "Yeah, see you." in this scene.

rows.en:
(Yui really loves tinkering with machines.
Well, I had fun too, so it was
a nice change of pace.)

(I came to Nyan-Nyan with Hoshimura
to get something to eat today, but...)

Oh, the maguro buns are all gone...
Excuse meee! Two more orders
of maguro buns, please!

I really think you're eating way too much...
Hoshimura...

Whaaat? This much is normal~
I haven't eaten nearly enough yet!

It seems the time has come
for me to show you my true power...
Excuse m...!
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Cut off by the player.

rows.en:
Hold it right there, Hoshimura!
Don't tell me I'm paying this time?

As if!
Kindly don't talk like I'm always
making you treat me.
rows.notes: Shared male/female. yoshite okure yo: old-fashioned, kept as "Kindly".

rows.en:
Naturally, we'll split the bill.
Honestly, I'm just so modest~

But even if we split it, you're the only one
eating all that, Hoshimura... So in the end,
aren't I the only one losing out...?

Excuse meee!!
Two more orders of Galaxy Ramen!!
Ah, Hoshimura!

(Sigh... It cost me a bundle, but it was
a nice change of pace, right? Probably...)

(I came to Nyan-Nyan with Yui
to get something to eat today, but...)

I really think you're eating way too much...
Yui...
O-Oh, I see...

Hold it right there, Yui!
Don't tell me I'm paying this time?

But even if we split it, you're the only one
eating all that, Yui... So in the end,
aren't I the only one losing out...?
Ah, Yui!

(Sigh... It cost me a bundle, but it was
a nice change of pace, right? Probably...)

(I came to the ranch on Island 3 with Hoshimura,
and man, hippo-cows sure are huge.)

So biiig~! Amaaazing~~! So cooool~~~!!!
Hey, hey, don't you think so too, \p?
They really are big...

Come to think of it, you've got Zentradi
blood in you too, right, Hoshimura?

Yup, that's right.
I am a quarter Zentradi, after all.
So does that mean you can macronize?

Hmm, I've never looked into it properly,
so I dunno... but I probably can, I'd guess?
Hah! I just thought of something amazing.

Maybe if I macronized,
my chest and stuff would go KA-BOOM huge,
and I'd be all sexy dynamite......

Yeah, that's not happening.
More importantly, let's go get a closer look
at the hippo-cows.
Whoa, what a cold reaction...
Oh well... Let's, let's!

Whew~, that was fun~
Let's definitely come again.

And next time, I'll macronize too
and get a dynamite body...
Okay, see ya.

(A macronized Hoshimura, huh...
I really doubt she'd end up
with a dynamite body, though...)

(I came to the ranch on Island 3 with Yui,
and wow, hippo-cows sure are huge.)
They really are big...

Come to think of it, you've got Zentradi
blood in you too, right, Yui?
So does that mean you can macronize?

Yeah, that's not happening.
More importantly, let's go get a closer look
at the hippo-cows.
See you.
rows.notes: Female. Female twin of male "See you." (c00305).

rows.en:
(A macronized Yui, huh...
I really doubt she'd end up
with a dynamite body, though...)

uncertain: c14828: sekushii dainamaitsu (a deliberately garbled "sexy dynamites") rendered "all sexy dynamite".
